name: ZEPHYR GE

specs.notes: An original, fictional single-seater for FORMULA APEX (the game's own series: no real team, car or branding), its numbers modelled on 2022-25 Formula 1 rules: 800 kg with the driver and without fuel (the FIA's 2025 minimum, up from 798 kg), ~45 % on the front (McLaren's MCL39: 44.6-46.1 %), a 1.6 V6 turbo hybrid revving to 15,000 rpm by the rules (fuel flow capped at 100 kg/h from 10,500 rpm, so the power is flat above it), a 120 kW MGU-K deploying 4 MJ a lap and recovering 2 MJ, eight gears, Pirelli 18 in slicks 305 / 405 mm wide and 720 mm across (the model's: 700 mm). The engine's ~590 kW (the combustion engine alone; ~710 kW with the MGU-K), its torque curve, the ratios, aero (CdA and downforce: a lift coefficient ~3.6 on ~1.5 m2, as published estimates for post-2017 cars put it) and DRS's effect are estimates. The model: a ground-effect car of the 2022-25 shape, a 3,575 mm wheelbase (the rules allowed up to 3,600).

garage.blurb: A FORMULA APEX ground-effect car: long, planted and sucked to the road by its floor. It gives up a little on the straights for more downforce in the fast corners.

interior.notes: An open cockpit under the halo: the model's tub, halo and screen, a race wheel added (tools/cars/formula_ge.json), the driver reclined with the helmet in the air.
